description: Agent Risk: submit one planned action and the effects it leaves outside itself: the action with its id, what it puts at stake, its unit and its description, read for wording that marks it final such as non-refundable, all sales final or cannot be undone; each effect with its id, what it leaves behind (such as the sent order or the moved funds), how it is undone (automatically, on request, by a compensating action such as a refund, not at all, or not known), what undoing it costs, how long undoing stays possible, whether undoing it needs the counterparty to agree and whether the undo has been run and worked; how long a mistake in the action takes to notice; and optionally the share of the action’s value at which an undo counts as costly (10 when left out). The signed report gives the action with any final wording, every effect with its undo, its cost and that cost’s share of the action’s value, its window in hours and its status as reversible, irreversible, closes_early, costly, needs_counterparty, compensating, unverified or unknown, and counts the effects reversible, irreversible, closing before a mistake is noticed, costly and unverified, and names an irreversible action: an effect that cannot be undone, an undo window that closes before a mistake would be noticed and wording that marks the action final; then an undo that costs a large share of the action’s value, an undo that needs the counterparty to agree and an effect undone only by a compensating action, with the fix for each. An undo not stated, untimed, uncosted or never run leaves the action unverified. This reads one action’s undo before it is taken, the undo side the Agent Recovery checks plan for after a failure: a task system’s undo design for the effects it leaves is wever_rollback-path-check, the record a recovery leaves is wever_recovery-record-check, recovering a lost result behind a settled payment is wever_payment-recovery-check, whether one move to a new system can be reversed is wever_migration-return-check and the reversibility of a money option is wever_money-fit-check. Verdict risk_irreversible, risk_reversal_costly, risk_reversal_unverified or risk_reversible. POST /api/risk-reversibility-check. Reads only the recorded material about the planned action in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, configuration change or external write; the planned action is not taken, paused, approved or undone and no limit, position or dependency is changed. Agent Risk reads the consequences of an action the agent plans to take, before it takes it: how much it puts at stake against the agent’s limits, whether it can be undone, how far a failure would spread beyond its target, the worst credible outcome against what the principal can absorb, whether it piles value into one place, what it depends on staying available or true, whether acting now is itself the risk and whether repeating or chaining it multiplies the risk. It is not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks read how sure the information behind a decision is; a risk check reads what the action costs if it goes wrong: uncertainty is about what the agent knows, risk is about what the action can do), not permission (wever_consent-scope-check reads whether the principal’s grant covers a use and wever_authority-scope-check reads whether the agent may act at all; a risk check reads the consequences of an action already permitted, and a permission never makes an action safe), not an agreement’s exposure (wever_negotiation-risk-check reads the value handed over before a counterparty pays under one proposed agreement; a risk check reads one action the agent is about to take) and not sorting work (the wever_triage checks sort, route and escalate a queue of work; a risk check assesses one planned action before it runs). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-risk-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-risk/.

description.description: The planned action as written, read for wording that marks it final, such as non-refundable or cannot be undone.

unit.description: The unit amounts are counted in, such as USDC.

value.description: What the action puts at stake.

cost_percent.description: An undo costing at or above this share of the action’s value counts as costly; 10 when left out.

effects.description: Each effect the action leaves outside itself.

id.description: The effect id, such as e1.

name.description: What the action leaves behind, such as the sent order.

needs_counterparty.description: Undoing it needs the counterparty to agree.

tested.description: The undo has been run and worked.

undo.description: How it is undone: automatically, on request, by a compensating action such as a refund, not at all, or not known.

window.description: How long undoing stays possible, such as 14 days.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

noticed_within.description: How long a mistake in the action takes to notice, such as 2 days.

name: wever_risk-reversibility-check
title: Risk reversibility check
